findings.summary: The README palette table describes StatusBackground/StatusText as the '`UPGRADE` status pill'. The status pill is the UpgradePending badge whose display text is template-driven and user-configurable (default template 'UPGRADE'), so a customized template means the pill may not literally read 'UPGRADE'.
findings.recommended_action: Optional clarification only; 'UPGRADE status pill' is consistent with the shipped default and config.html's 'Upgrade status' labels, so no correction is required unless the maintainer prefers 'upgrade-status pill (default text UPGRADE)'.

summary: The task 13.1 deliverable is accurate. The new README 'Renderer palette overrides' section matches the shipped code exactly: the four defaults (#111827, #FFFFFF, #B45309, #FFFFFF) come from RenderOutputPolicy.Default, the RRGGBB/empty-keeps-default semantics match RgbColor/RendererPalette, and the 4.5:1 pair rule matches BadgeContrast.MinimumRatio plus RendererConfiguration.ValidatePalette and last-valid retention. The pre-existing v1.1 README claims (elevation-gated settings UI, pre-save validation/post-save bounded reconciliation, per-operation restart-free activation with the construction-captured residual, case-insensitive bounded allowlist, position/size semantics, bounded LogVerbosity, and the F1 inventory cache with F1 resolved) all match source and the canonical docs, and no stale 'no web configuration UI' or restart-required-for-saved-changes claim remains. Phase 13 is not overclaimed (acceptance criteria unchecked, Gate 13/tag not claimed) and no V1 history was rewritten. One MEDIUM current-state inconsistency remains in PLANS.md itself: Milestone Status row 13 still says 'Not started' although task 13.1 is complete; this should be corrected (or explicitly handed to the orchestrator for phase closure). Two LOW notes are informational/deferred. No edits were made by this review.
